t: Which of the following plant and machinery shall be classified under stationary plant?

II. Declared gross profit
III. Market value of the project insured.
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

o: Recoverable amount is reduced in such proportion as the sum insured bears to the amount required to be insured
Recoverable amount is increased in such proportion
e: Correct answer: Recoverable amount is reduced in such proportion as the sum insured bears to the amount required to be insured (from the IC77 question bank).

Which of the following losses shall be covered under electronic equipment insurance?
